description: Create a flashcard deck. Required: title (3-120 chars) and cards[] (min 1). Optional: description (≤1200 chars), tags (≤50 each).

cards.description: Flashcards in the deck; at least one card is required.

back.description: Text shown on the back of the flashcard (the answer).

front.description: Text shown on the front of the flashcard (the prompt).

hint.description: Optional hint shown before revealing the back of the card.

order.description: 1-indexed display order of the card within the deck.

tags.description: Optional tags to categorize the deck (≤50 characters each).

name: quiz_video_create_flashcard_deck
title: Create a flashcard deck
